cosmicRules.magic: Discord energy corrupts all forms of magic; stable arcane structures require Riftseeker containment.
cosmicRules.space: Spatial geometry is unstable; regions may fold, loop, or distort.
cosmicRules.time: Temporal fractures allow simultaneous past, present, and future states.
cosmicRules.travel: Movement between realms is primarily through Discord rifts or Riftseeker anchors.
